paragraphs.dominant_move: Open with the decision object before listing methods. -> supplies an inspectable output -> hands it to the next paragraph or section
Name the comparison universe before proposing a winner. -> supplies an inspectable output -> hands it to the next paragraph or section
Hand operational claims to a named simulator and measured outputs. -> supplies an inspectable output -> hands it to the next paragraph or section
Introduce a multi-index ranking layer after collecting simulation data. -> supplies an inspectable output -> hands it to the next paragraph or section
Declare a surrogate and its interpretation instead of hiding it. -> supplies an inspectable output -> hands it to the next paragraph or section
Separate continuous cost optimization from pattern selection. -> supplies an inspectable output -> hands it to the next paragraph or section
Assign topology allocation to a distinct optimization model. -> supplies an inspectable output -> hands it to the next paragraph or section
Close with regime and composition adjustments, not an unqualified guarantee. -> supplies an inspectable output -> hands it to the next paragraph or section
Mark sensitivity as local solver output with a named tool. -> supplies an inspectable output -> hands it to the next paragraph or section
Use a bounded conclusion whose deployment meaning requires later evidence. -> supplies an inspectable output -> hands it to the next paragraph or section
Establish the public-road context before the local toll mechanism. -> supplies an inspectable output -> hands it to the next paragraph or section
Use an attributed problem statement to motivate the intervention. -> supplies an inspectable output -> hands it to the next paragraph or section
Explain why fan-in is the structural source of post-toll merging. -> supplies an inspectable output -> hands it to the next paragraph or section
Name the geometric transition that downstream models must represent. -> supplies an inspectable output -> hands it to the next paragraph or section
Connect a cited mechanism to queue and collision objectives. -> supplies an inspectable output -> hands it to the next paragraph or section
Enumerate design factors before quantification. -> supplies an inspectable output -> hands it to the next paragraph or section
Present the three objectives without claiming they share one metric. -> supplies an inspectable output -> hands it to the next paragraph or section
Make scenario dependence part of the original task. -> supplies an inspectable output -> hands it to the next paragraph or section

global_organization_chain: post-toll fan-in congestion, accident, throughput, and cost problem
four-part requirement map and conditional assumptions
two-shape by two-size by two-pattern taxonomy
VISSIM geometry, demand, conflict, detector, and queue configuration
complete five-index table for eight cases
PCA direction transform, normalization, correlation, contribution, retention, and ranking
half-height experiment that rejects a simple monotonic size assumption
Fourier influx, traveler/booth/construction cost, waiting components, stationary B and H
transition-matrix balance, path geometry, LP objective, and paired-booth lane assignment
return of the selected design to VISSIM and PCA
light/heavy traffic, autonomous vehicle, and booth-composition adjustments
LINGO local reduced-cost and allowable-range sensitivity
source strengths and weaknesses followed by an authority-facing recommendation

only after positive language, organization, model, and visual retention does the final warning pass record arithmetic, notation, dimensional, integer, domain, simulator, safety, and robustness defects

moves: input: Post-toll merging creates a design decision over geometry, traffic, safety, and cost.
rhetorical job: Preview the classification, simulation, PCA, optimization, and conditional adjustments in the order used by the paper.
analytical job: Keep each headline result attached to its producing experiment or model rather than collapsing them into one feasibility claim.
output: A selected trapezoid layout, a cost/height optimum, and a transition-matrix recommendation with explicit scenario limits.
handoff: The introduction supplies the toll-plaza mechanism, task decomposition, and assumptions behind the summary.
section_progressions.positive_pattern: Retain the source-anchored input -> rhetorical job -> analytical job -> output -> handoff contract; warnings remain the final pass.

moves: input: Toll plazas fan traffic from more booth exits into fewer highway lanes, concentrating queue and conflict pressure.
rhetorical job: Move from public-road pressure through the post-toll mechanism to the four-part problem decomposition.
analytical job: Keep congestion, accidents, cost, throughput, shape, size, and merge pattern as separate analytical inputs.
output: A testable requirement set for a post-toll area rather than a generic traffic-improvement slogan.
handoff: The work overview and assumptions turn those requirements into a closed modeling boundary.
section_progressions.positive_pattern: Retain the source-anchored input -> rhetorical job -> analytical job -> output -> handoff contract; warnings remain the final pass.

moves: input: The prompt is recast as design classification, traffic simulation, comprehensive evaluation, and improvement search.
rhetorical job: Use a numbered work map that lets the reader audit whether each requested decision has a downstream artifact.
analytical job: Assign existing-design comparison, simulation, rating, and better-solution search to distinct stages.
output: A requirement-to-method chain from eight design classes through simulation and evaluation to optimization.
handoff: General assumptions bound the resulting chain before parameters are assigned.
section_progressions.positive_pattern: Retain the source-anchored input -> rhetorical job -> analytical job -> output -> handoff contract; warnings remain the final pass.

moves: input: A tractable simulation and evaluation requires bounded driver behavior, vehicle class, weather, toll operation, and queue interaction.
rhetorical job: List assumptions as a visible ledger, then preserve their implications for every later result.
analytical job: Distinguish behavioral exclusions from physical operating conditions and from independence assumptions.
output: A conditional evidence domain: cars, normal speed, all-day booths, no modeled accidents from violations, and no queue feedback to booths.
handoff: The design classification and VISSIM configuration instantiate these assumptions.
section_progressions.positive_pattern: Retain the source-anchored input -> rhetorical job -> analytical job -> output -> handoff contract; warnings remain the final pass.

moves: input: The post-toll region varies by trapezoid shape, area height/size, and whether lane choices are normal or stipulated.
rhetorical job: Introduce a compact factorial design before simulation so every model label has a geometric and routing meaning.
analytical job: Map shape, size ratio, and merge pattern to eight named cases, preserving the source's abstraction from satellite observations.
output: Eight reproducible design cells: two shapes times two sizes times two merge patterns.
handoff: The simulation model fixes L, B, widths, speed, flow, and detector outputs for all eight cells.
section_progressions.positive_pattern: Retain the source-anchored input -> rhetorical job -> analytical job -> output -> handoff contract; warnings remain the final pass.

moves: input: The simulation and cost model use lane, booth, width, speed, time, flow, service, and cost symbols with different units.
rhetorical job: Introduce symbols at the point where a table, parameter calculation, or equation consumes them.
analytical job: Keep simulation quantities (T,L,B,d,D,In,V) separate from cost quantities (C,W1,W2,W3,v,mu,n,C1,C2,F,O,s,k).
output: A typed symbol interface that allows later equations and tables to be checked without guessing units.
handoff: Parameter assignment and optimization consume these symbols and expose where source units remain unclear.
section_progressions.positive_pattern: Retain the source-anchored input -> rhetorical job -> analytical job -> output -> handoff contract; warnings remain the final pass.

moves: input: Eight VISSIM cases and the cost model require fixed geometry, flow, toll service, and a fitted influx signal.
rhetorical job: State each value with its source or simplifying choice, then show the conversion that creates a downstream input.
analytical job: Distinguish directly set parameters, cited values, arithmetic derivations, simulated outputs, and a Fourier fit from prior data.
output: A scenario ledger with L=3, B=8, d=3.5 m, D=5.5 m, v=120 km/h, 3600 s, 2400 veh/h ingress, and an eight-term F(t).
handoff: The PCA table and cost equations consume these values with their uncertainty and missing-data boundaries preserved.
section_progressions.positive_pattern: Retain the source-anchored input -> rhetorical job -> analytical job -> output -> handoff contract; warnings remain the final pass.

moves: input: The eight classified cases produce throughput, delay, queue length, merge-point count, and height for a multi-index comparison.
rhetorical job: Move from detector design through PCA normalization, correlation, eigenvalue contributions, score, and the size follow-up experiment.
analytical job: Keep simulated values, transformed indices, principal components, and the ranking decision as separate evidence layers.
output: Model 7 receives the highest printed score, while the text also reports a shape interpretation that must be checked against the labels.
handoff: The optimum-solution section consumes the ranking and adds continuous cost and discrete routing models.
section_progressions.positive_pattern: Retain the source-anchored input -> rhetorical job -> analytical job -> output -> handoff contract; warnings remain the final pass.

moves: input: Influx, outflux, booth count, height, lane routing, and path length determine the continuous and discrete optimum.
rhetorical job: Trace Fourier demand through waiting integrals and derivatives, then switch to a transition matrix and shortest-path linear program.
analytical job: Retain equation order, variable definitions, objective direction, constraints, and the source's undefined or discrete quantities.
output: B=6 and H=35.6472 m are reported by the cost model; T assigns pairs of tollbooths to three lanes under the path objective.
handoff: The model-testing simulation compares this selected solution with the eight classified cases.
section_progressions.positive_pattern: Retain the source-anchored input -> rhetorical job -> analytical job -> output -> handoff contract; warnings remain the final pass.

moves: input: The selected design is tested, then adjusted for light/heavy flow, autonomous vehicles, and booth composition.
rhetorical job: Present each adjustment as a conditional response to a changed demand or vehicle class, keeping the original optimum as the baseline.
analytical job: Separate the model test from claims about traffic regimes, autonomy, and heterogeneous toll service.
output: A scenario-dependent recommendation: close excess booths in light flow, alter routing in heavy flow, and reweight P for booth types.
handoff: Sensitivity analysis examines the transition matrix locally after these modifications.
section_progressions.positive_pattern: Retain the source-anchored input -> rhetorical job -> analytical job -> output -> handoff contract; warnings remain the final pass.

moves: input: The simulation table and PCA ranking provide the first empirical comparison of the eight classified designs.
rhetorical job: Report the table, the selected rank, the half-height follow-up, and the mismatch between prose and labels.
analytical job: Keep each number tied to a model, metric, unit, and source table; do not convert the ranking into universal shape superiority.
output: Kind 7 has throughput 2301 veh/h, delay 5.8 s, queue 8.13 m, and 7 merge points; the score table ranks it first at 2.5822.
handoff: The optimum solution expands the score comparison with cost and transition-matrix decisions.
section_progressions.positive_pattern: Retain the source-anchored input -> rhetorical job -> analytical job -> output -> handoff contract; warnings remain the final pass.

moves: input: The transition matrix is perturbed with LINGO reduced costs and variable change ranges.
rhetorical job: Describe what the solver reports and which local variables drive the objective without upgrading it to global robustness.
analytical job: Distinguish objective sensitivity for t13/t61 from construction-variable ranges and retain the plotted evidence boundary.
output: The source flags t13 and t61 as costly unit increases and presents a local allowable-error range.
handoff: The weaknesses and independent extensions define the missing global, scenario, and uncertainty checks.
section_progressions.positive_pattern: Retain the source-anchored input -> rhetorical job -> analytical job -> output -> handoff contract; warnings remain the final pass.

moves: input: The conclusion inventory claims applicability, a global optimum, flexibility, and technical support, then names data and simulation weaknesses.
rhetorical job: Let the source's self-critique follow the positive summary so limitations remain a final-pass qualification.
analytical job: Separate model adaptability from parameter accuracy, simplifying assumptions, and missing real-world data.
output: A reusable pattern for paired contribution and weakness records, without treating a claimed global optimum as verified.
handoff: The memo and conclusion carry the recommendation into an administrative decision context.
section_progressions.positive_pattern: Retain the source-anchored input -> rhetorical job -> analytical job -> output -> handoff contract; warnings remain the final pass.

moves: input: The paper closes by coupling its geometric, optimization, and simulation claims with explicit caveats.
rhetorical job: Synthesize the chain in the same order as the work map, then stop before presenting deployment as established fact.
analytical job: Distinguish what was computed, what was simulated, what was assumed, and what remains unvalidated.
output: A conclusion that is useful for deciding what to test next, not a substitute for field calibration or safety evidence.
handoff: The authority letter restates this conditional decision path for the New Jersey Turnpike Authority.
section_progressions.positive_pattern: Retain the source-anchored input -> rhetorical job -> analytical job -> output -> handoff contract; warnings remain the final pass.

moves: input: The authority letter translates classification, simulation, PCA, cost, LP, traffic, autonomy, and booth-composition findings into advice.
rhetorical job: Use an audience-facing sequence that mirrors the paper's technical chain and then gives conditional operating actions.
analytical job: Keep administrative recommendations tied to their source pages, regimes, and missing validation rather than treating the letter as new data.
output: A staged recommendation: compare existing forms, test the selected cellular design, close excess booths in light flow, divert heavy flow, and re-evaluate adoption.
handoff: The closing asks for overall real-world consideration and leaves construction decisions with the authority.
section_progressions.positive_pattern: Retain the source-anchored input -> rhetorical job -> analytical job -> output -> handoff contract; warnings remain the final pass.

moves: input: References, the authority letter, and four-dimensional model graphics preserve provenance and communication context.
rhetorical job: Record external sources and visual artifacts after the substantive argument while keeping them out of the positive model proof.
analytical job: Distinguish cited capacity/autonomy facts, visible matrices and plots, and missing original data or executable files.
output: A provenance and visualization tail that makes the paper auditable without adding unsupported validation.
handoff: The final artifact retains the PDF's 21 physical pages and all visual/table anchors.

main_argument_chains.claim: Observed post-toll areas can be organized into eight inspectable design cases.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: use the taxonomy as a comparison frame while requiring a representative plaza inventory and corrected size geometry

main_argument_chains.claim: VISSIM outputs and PCA can rank the eight designs on cost, traffic, and accident-prevention surrogates.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: retain model 7's printed rank while requiring a reproducible PCA ledger, calibrated simulation, and validated safety measure

main_argument_chains.claim: Traveler time, booth operation, and construction cost can jointly select B and H.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: treat the reported optimum as a candidate until integrals, costs, units, integer B, bounds, and global search are rebuilt

main_argument_chains.claim: A transition matrix can turn a desired merge pattern into booth-to-lane assignments.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: retain the allocation interface while defining SD, all constraints, geometry, and validated operational objectives

main_argument_chains.claim: The selected candidate improves the paper's comprehensive score.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: preserve the reported score as an unreplicated same-pipeline test rather than independent validation

main_argument_chains.claim: The design and routing can be adjusted across traffic, autonomy, and booth-composition scenarios.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: build a controlled joint scenario surface and global uncertainty analysis before operational or construction use

main_argument_chains.claim: The authority letter converts the modeling chain into conditional public-agency advice.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: use the letter as a staged validation agenda rather than evidence that the design is feasible

warnings.warning: The printed standard-deviation expression appears to use mu_i where the column mean mu_j is required.
The reciprocal transformation, normalized table, eigenvectors, percentage convention, and score rounding are not archived for exact reproduction.
Equation (7) repeats cos(t omega) where a fifth harmonic may be intended and mixes minute language with a 24-hour omega.
The W1 integral has malformed limits and mixed variables, leaving its dimensional and queue interpretation unclear.
The W3 integral repeats the malformed construction and depends on unarchived O(t,B) and k.
The model differentiates discrete booth count B and does not enumerate neighboring integers or prove a global mixed-domain optimum.
Equation (15) uses undefined SD, so the path geometry cannot be independently reconstructed.
